blocks.text: Qizil kitobda **want to**, **decide to**, **promise to** kabi asosiy fe'llarni ko'rganmiz (→ qizil kitob, 52-dars). Bu fe'llarning ko'pi **kelajakka** qaraydi: qaror, reja, va'da, rozilik, urinish — harakat hali bajarilmagan yoki natijasi hali noma'lum. O'zbekchada ular odatda «-ish**ga**» (borishga qaror qildi), «-moqchi» (ketmoqchi edi) yoki «-ish**ni**» (yordam berishni taklif qildi) bilan beriladi. Bu darsda ro'yxatni kengaytiramiz va uchta murakkab joyni ko'ramiz: **seem / appear / pretend** dan keyingi **to be doing** va **to have done**, inkor (**not to**) hamda savol so'zi + to (**what to do**, **how to get**).

rows: We **can't afford to lose** this client.

items.text: After a long discussion, the board **agreed to invest** in the new factory.
items.translation: Uzoq muhokamadan so'ng direktorlar kengashi yangi zavodga **sarmoya kiritishga rozi bo'ldi**.

items.text: Bekzod **offered to drive** us to the airport at five in the morning.
items.translation: Bekzod bizni tongi soat beshda aeroportga **olib borishni taklif qildi**.

items.text: The landlord **threatened to raise** the rent if we kept the dog.
items.translation: Uy egasi, itni qoldirsak, ijara haqini **oshirishini aytib do'q qildi**.

blocks.text: manage, fail, afford, tend — nozik ma'nolar

**manage to** — qiyinchilikka qaramay **uddalamoq**: I **managed to find** a parking space — «Mashina qo'yishga joy topib oldim». O'tgan zamondagi bir martalik muvaffaqiyat uchun **could** emas, **managed to** yoki **was able to** ishlatiladi (→ 26-dars). **fail to** — aksincha, «-a olmadi» yoki oddiy «-madi», asosan rasmiy matn va yangiliklarda: The government **failed to keep** its promise. **can't afford to** — pul (ba'zan vaqt yoki xavf) ko'tara olmaslik: We **can't afford to make** another mistake — «Yana xato qilishga haqqimiz yo'q». **tend to** — odat va umumiy tendensiya, o'zbekchadagi «odatda» ning aynan o'zi.

rows: People **tend to sleep** less in summer.

blocks.text: Ikkinchi fe'lni inkor qilish uchun **not** to dan oldin qo'yiladi: She **decided not to go** — «Bormaslikka qaror qildi». Birinchi fe'lning inkori boshqa narsa: She **didn't decide to go** — «Borishga qaror qilmadi» (balki hali hech narsa hal qilmagan). O'zbekchada **not to** ga «-maslik**ka**» to'g'ri keladi: aytmaslikka va'da berdi, kutmaslikka kelishdik. Ba'zi fe'llarning ma'nosi o'zi inkor: **refuse to** — «-ishdan bosh tortmoq», **fail to** — «-a olmaslik», shuning uchun ular bilan not deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

items.text: We **agreed not to discuss** work during the holiday.
He **pretended not to notice** that I was twenty minutes late.
I **promise not to tell** anyone what happened at the meeting.
items.translation: Yig'ilishda nima bo'lganini hech kimga **aytmaslikka va'da beraman**.

blocks.text: seem, appear, pretend: to be doing va to have done

**seem** va **appear** (o'xshamoq, ko'rinmoq), **pretend** (o'zini ... qilib ko'rsatmoq), **claim** (da'vo qilmoq), **tend** (moyil bo'lmoq) dan keyin infinitivning to'rt shakli keladi. Oddiy **to do** — hozirgi yoki umumiy holat; **to be doing** — ayni paytda davom etayotgan harakat; **to have done** — avvalroq bo'lib o'tgan harakat; **to have been doing** — avvaldan davom etib kelgan harakat. Bu shakllar **It seems that ...** gapining qisqa varianti: He **seems to have left** = It seems that he **has left**. O'zbekchada «-ganga o'xshaydi», «-yotganga o'xshaydi», «shekilli» to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: The printer **appears to be working** again, so let's try once more.
items.translation: Printer yana **ishlayotganga o'xshaydi**, keling, yana bir urinib ko'raylik.

items.text: Oliver **claims to have met** the Queen when he was a child.
items.translation: Oliver bolaligida qirolicha bilan **uchrashganini da'vo qiladi**.

items.text: The kids **pretended to be doing** their homework when I walked in.
items.translation: Men kirganimda bolalar o'zlarini uy vazifasini **qilayotganga solishdi**.

blocks.text: **seem** ning inkori ikki xil: He **doesn't seem to like** me = He **seems not to like** me. Birinchisi kundalik nutqda ancha odatiy. **There seems to be** ... — «... borga o'xshaydi»: There **seems to be** a mistake in the bill — «Hisobda xato borga o'xshaydi». **dare** dan keyin to tushib qolishi mumkin: I **didn't dare (to) ask** him.
Savol so'zi + to: what to do, how to get there

**know, decide, ask, wonder, remember, forget, explain, learn, show, tell** dan keyin savol so'zi (what, how, where, when, which, who, whether) va **to** kelishi mumkin: I don't know **what to do** — «Nima qilishni bilmayman». Bu o'zbekcha qolipga juda mos: qayerga borish**ni**, kim bilan gaplashish**ni**. Ma'nosi — «nima qilish kerak / nima qilsam bo'ladi»: I don't know what **to say** = I don't know what **I should say**. **whether to** — «-sammi yoki yo'qmi»: We can't decide **whether to stay** or leave. **why** bilan bu qolip ishlatilmaydi. Kishini to'g'ri joylashtiring: Can you **show me how to** use it?, lekin **explain to me how to** ... (explain dan keyin kishi to bilan).

items.text: Nobody told me **where to park**, so I left the car outside the gate.
items.translation: Hech kim menga mashinani **qayerga qo'yishni** aytmadi, shuning uchun uni darvoza oldida qoldirdim.

items.text: I'm still wondering **whether to accept** the job in Manchester.
items.translation: Manchesterdagi ishni **qabul qilsammi-yo'qmi**, hali ham o'ylab yuribman.

items.text: Could you explain to me **how to fill in** this form?
items.translation: Bu anketani **qanday to'ldirishni** menga tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I decided going abroad.» → I **decided to go** abroad.; «He refused helping me.» → He **refused to help** me.; «We can't afford buying a flat.» → We **can't afford to buy** a flat.; «She pretended sleeping.» → She **pretended to be asleep**.; «I don't know what should I do.» → I don't know **what to do** / what **I should** do.; «Explain me how to ...» → **Explain to me** how to ...; «Yesterday I could finish the report» (bir martalik natija) → I **managed to finish** / **was able to finish** the report.

Eslab qolish: o'zbekchada «-ish**ga**» (qaror qildi, rozi bo'ldi, va'da berdi, muvaffaq bo'ldi) yoki «-moqchi» bo'lsa — ko'pincha **to**. «-gan**ga** o'xshaydi» — **seem to have done**, «-yotgan**ga** o'xshaydi» — **seem to be doing**, «nima / qayerga / qanday ... -ishni» — **what / where / how to**.

examples.title: Plans and decisions: **decide**, **plan**, **arrange**
examples.description: Qaror, reja va kelishuv fe'llari — hammasi kelajakka qaragan, shuning uchun **to** bilan: «-ishga qaror qildi», «-ishni rejalashtirdi».

sentences.text: After months of discussion, Dilnoza **decided to study** law in London.
sentences.translation: Bir necha oylik muhokamadan so'ng Dilnoza Londonda huquqshunoslik **o'qishga qaror qildi**.

sentences.text: We've **arranged to meet** the architect on Thursday to discuss the new kitchen.
sentences.translation: Yangi oshxonani muhokama qilish uchun payshanba kuni me'mor bilan **uchrashishni kelishib oldik**.

sentences.text: Are you **planning to buy** a flat, or will you keep renting?
sentences.translation: Kvartira **sotib olishni rejalashtiryapsizmi** yoki ijarada yashashda davom etasizmi?

sentences.text: The two companies **have agreed to share** the cost of the research.
sentences.translation: Ikki kompaniya tadqiqot xarajatlarini **teng ko'tarishga kelishdi**.

sentences.text: My sister **aims to run** a marathon before she turns forty.
sentences.translation: Opam qirq yoshga to'lmasdan marafon **yugurishni maqsad qilgan**.

sentences.text: When the bus didn't come, we **decided to walk** the last three kilometres.
sentences.translation: Avtobus kelmagach, oxirgi uch kilometrni **piyoda yurishga qaror qildik**.

sentences.text: Who **agreed to organise** the end-of-year party? — I think it was Kate.
sentences.translation: Yil yakuni bazmini kim **tashkil qilishga rozi bo'ldi**? — Menimcha, Keyt.

sentences.text: The city **plans to open** three new metro stations by 2030.
sentences.translation: Shahar 2030-yilgacha uchta yangi metro bekatini **ochishni rejalashtirmoqda**.

sentences.text: James has **arranged to work** from home on Fridays so that he can collect his son from school.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'g'lini maktabdan olib kelishi uchun juma kunlari uydan **ishlashni kelishib oldi**.

sentences.text: In the end, Aziz **chose to stay** in Fergana and help his father with the business.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat Aziz Farg'onada **qolib**, otasiga biznesda yordam berishni **tanladi**.

examples.title: **promise**, **offer**, **refuse**, **threaten**
examples.description: Va'da, taklif, rad etish va tahdid — boshqalar bilan munosabatdagi fe'llar. refuse to — «-ishdan bosh tortmoq», threaten to — «-ishini aytib do'q qilmoq».

sentences.text: Jasur **promised to call** me as soon as he landed in Seoul.
sentences.translation: Jasur Seulga qo'nishi bilan menga **qo'ng'iroq qilishga va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: A neighbour **offered to look after** our cat while we were on holiday.
sentences.translation: Ta'tildaligimizda qo'shnimiz mushugimizga **qarab turishni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: The bank **refused to lend** us the money because our income was too low.
sentences.translation: Daromadimiz juda past bo'lgani uchun bank bizga **qarz berishdan bosh tortdi**.

sentences.text: The workers **threatened to go** on strike if their wages weren't increased.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar, agar maoshlari oshirilmasa, **ish tashlashini aytib tahdid qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Why did you **offer to help** Sarah with her move? You hate carrying boxes!
sentences.translation: Nega Saraga ko'chishda **yordam berishni taklif qilding**? Quti tashishni yomon ko'rasan-ku!

sentences.text: The witness **refused to answer** any questions without a lawyer present.
sentences.translation: Guvoh advokatsiz hech qanday savolga **javob berishdan bosh tortdi**.

sentences.text: You **promised to fix** the tap last weekend, and it's still dripping!
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kuni jo'mrakni **tuzatishga va'da bergan eding**, u hali ham tomchilayapti!

sentences.text: My landlord **has threatened to sell** the flat if I complain again.
sentences.translation: Uy egam, yana shikoyat qilsam, kvartirani **sotib yuborishini aytib qo'rqitdi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **volunteered to translate** the documents into English for free.
sentences.translation: Nilufar hujjatlarni bepul ingliz tiliga **tarjima qilishga ko'ngilli bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Did the shop **agree to give** you a refund, or did they **refuse to**?
sentences.translation: Do'kon pulingizni **qaytarishga rozi bo'ldimi** yoki **bosh tortdimi**?

examples.title: Success and failure: **manage**, **fail**, **afford**
examples.description: manage to — qiyinchilikka qaramay uddalash, fail to — uddalay olmaslik, can't afford to — pul yoki imkoniyat yetmasligi, deserve to — loyiq bo'lish.

sentences.text: The roads were icy, but we **managed to get** home before midnight.
sentences.translation: Yo'llar muz edi, lekin yarim tungacha uyga **yetib olishga muvaffaq bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: Despite all her efforts, Kate **failed to get** a place at Oxford.
sentences.translation: Barcha urinishlariga qaramay, Keyt Oksfordga **o'qishga kira olmadi**.

sentences.text: We **can't afford to go** abroad this summer, so we're staying with my aunt in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz chet elga **borishga pulimiz yetmaydi**, shuning uchun Buxorodagi xolamnikida dam olamiz.

sentences.text: After all that hard work, you **deserve to have** a proper rest.
sentences.translation: Shuncha mehnatdan keyin siz yaxshilab **dam olishga loyiqsiz**.

sentences.text: How did you **manage to finish** the project so quickly? — I worked every evening.
sentences.translation: Loyihani qanday qilib bunchalik tez **tugatib ulgurdingiz**? — Har kuni kechqurun ishladim.

sentences.text: The new law **failed to reduce** the number of accidents on the roads.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun yo'llardagi baxtsiz hodisalar sonini **kamaytira olmadi**.

sentences.text: A small company **can't afford to lose** its biggest client.
sentences.translation: Kichik kompaniya eng yirik mijozini **yo'qotishni ko'tara olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **managed to persuade** his parents to let him travel alone.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yolg'iz sayohat qilishiga ruxsat berishlari uchun ota-onasini **ko'ndira oldi**.

sentences.text: The team played so badly that they didn't **deserve to win**.
sentences.translation: Jamoa shunchalik yomon o'ynadiki, **g'alabaga loyiq emas edi**.

sentences.text: Several passengers **failed to notice** the warning signs and missed the last train.
sentences.translation: Bir necha yo'lovchi ogohlantirish belgilarini **payqamay qolib**, oxirgi poyezdga ulgurmadi.

examples.title: Appearances: **seem**, **appear**, **tend**, **pretend**
examples.description: Tashqi ko'rinish (seem, appear), odat (tend), soxta ko'rinish (pretend) va da'vo (claim). There **seems to be** — «... borga o'xshaydi».

sentences.text: Your new colleague **seems to know** a lot about computers.
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasbingiz kompyuterlar haqida ko'p narsa **biladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: The situation **appears to be** under control, according to the police.
sentences.translation: Politsiyaning ma'lumotiga ko'ra, vaziyat nazorat ostida **ko'rinadi**.

sentences.text: People in big cities **tend to walk** faster than people in villages.
sentences.translation: Katta shaharlardagi odamlar qishloqdagilarga qaraganda **odatda** tezroq **yuradi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **pretended to be** ill so that he could miss the test.
sentences.translation: Bekzod testga kirmaslik uchun o'zini **kasalga soldi**.

sentences.text: The man on the phone **claimed to work** for my bank, but it was a scam.
sentences.translation: Telefondagi odam mening bankimda **ishlashini da'vo qildi**, lekin bu firibgarlik edi.

sentences.text: Madina **doesn't seem to be** very happy in her new job.
sentences.translation: Madina yangi ishidan unchalik **mamnun emasga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: I **tend to get** headaches when I spend too long in front of a screen.
sentences.translation: Ekran oldida uzoq o'tirsam, **odatda** boshim **og'riydi**.

sentences.text: There **seems to be** a problem with your visa application.
sentences.translation: Viza arizangizda muammo **borga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: The children **pretended to be** dinosaurs and ran around the garden roaring.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **dinozavr bo'lib o'ynab**, bo'kirgancha bog'da yugurishdi.

sentences.text: Older drivers **tend to be** more careful, but they also react more slowly.
sentences.translation: Keksa haydovchilar **odatda** ehtiyotkorroq **bo'ladi**, lekin ularning reaksiyasi ham sekinroq.

examples.title: **seem to be doing** / **seem to have done**
examples.description: to be + -ing — ayni paytdagi jarayon («-yotganga o'xshaydi»), to have + V3 — avval bo'lgan harakat («-ganga o'xshaydi»), to have been + -ing — avvaldan davom etgan harakat.

sentences.text: The kids are very quiet — they **seem to be watching** something on the tablet.
sentences.translation: Bolalar juda jim — planshetda nimadir **tomosha qilayotganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I **seem to have left** my wallet at the restaurant!
sentences.translation: Voy, hamyonimni restoranda **qoldirib ketibman shekilli**!

sentences.text: Your English **appears to have improved** a lot since your trip to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga safaringizdan beri ingliz tilingiz ancha **yaxshilanganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: When I came into the office, Oliver **pretended to be working**, but he was clearly playing a game.
sentences.translation: Ofisga kirganimda Oliver o'zini **ishlayotganga soldi**, lekin u aniq o'yin o'ynayotgan edi.

sentences.text: The thieves **appear to have entered** the building through a back window.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar binoga orqa derazadan **kirganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **claims to have read** every book in his father's library.
sentences.translation: Aziz otasining kutubxonasidagi har bir kitobni **o'qiganini da'vo qiladi**.

sentences.text: Her eyes were red — she **seemed to have been crying** for a long time.
sentences.translation: Ko'zlari qizarib ketgan edi — uzoq vaqt **yig'laganga o'xshardi**.

sentences.text: Is it just me, or **does** the wifi **seem to be getting** slower every day?
sentences.translation: Faqat menga shundaymi yoki wifi kundan-kunga **sekinlashib borayotganga o'xshaydimi**?

sentences.text: Nobody **seems to have noticed** that the meeting room is double-booked.
sentences.translation: Majlislar xonasi ikki marta band qilinganini hech kim **sezmaganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Emma **pretended to have forgotten** my birthday, but she was secretly planning a party.
sentences.translation: Emma tug'ilgan kunimni **unutgandek ko'rsatdi**, aslida esa yashirincha ziyofat tayyorlayotgan edi.

examples.title: Negative: **decided not to**, **promised not to**
examples.description: Ikkinchi fe'lning inkori — **not to** («-maslikka»). Birinchi fe'lning inkori (didn't decide to) bilan farqiga e'tibor bering.

sentences.text: Because of the storm, we **decided not to drive** to Khiva that day.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron tufayli o'sha kuni Xivaga mashinada **bormaslikka qaror qildik**.

sentences.text: Sarah **promised not to tell** anyone about my new job until it was official.
sentences.translation: Sara yangi ishim rasmiylashmaguncha hech kimga **aytmaslikka va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **pretended not to see** me when I waved at him across the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaning narigi tomonidan qo'l silkitganimda, Bekzod meni **ko'rmaganga oldi**.

sentences.text: We **agreed not to buy** each other presents this year and to give the money to charity instead.
sentences.translation: Bu yil bir-birimizga **sovg'a olmaslikka**, o'rniga pulni xayriyaga berishga **kelishdik**.

sentences.text: Most passengers **chose not to wait** for the next flight and took the train instead.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik yo'lovchilar keyingi reysni **kutmaslikni tanlab**, poyezdda ketishdi.

sentences.text: Why did Tom **decide not to come** to the wedding? Is he still angry with us?
sentences.translation: Nega Tom to'yga **kelmaslikka qaror qildi**? Hali ham bizdan xafami?

sentences.text: I **didn't decide to leave** — the company closed, so I had no choice.
sentences.translation: Men ketishga **qaror qilmagandim** — kompaniya yopildi, boshqa ilojim yo'q edi.

sentences.text: The company **promised not to raise** prices for at least a year.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kamida bir yil narxlarni **oshirmaslikka va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **seems not to care** about the exam, which worries her parents.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza imtihonga **parvo qilmayotganga o'xshaydi**, bu ota-onasini xavotirga solyapti.

sentences.text: In the end, Oliver **decided not to sell** his old guitar, because it reminded him of his dad.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat Oliver eski gitarasini **sotmaslikka qaror qildi**, chunki u otasini eslatardi.

examples.title: Question word + **to**: **what to do**, **how to** ...
examples.description: know, decide, ask, explain, show, wonder dan keyin savol so'zi + to: «nima qilishni», «qayerga borishni», «qanday ... -ishni». whether to — «-sammi yoki yo'qmi».

sentences.text: I've got two job offers and I don't know **which one to choose**.
sentences.translation: Ikkita ish taklifi bor, **qaysi birini tanlashni** bilmayman.

sentences.text: Could you show me **how to change** the settings on this phone?
sentences.translation: Bu telefonda sozlamalarni **qanday o'zgartirishni** ko'rsatib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: We haven't decided **where to go** for our honeymoon yet.
sentences.translation: Asal oyimizni **qayerda o'tkazishni** hali hal qilmadik.

sentences.text: Nobody explained to the new staff **what to do** in case of fire.
sentences.translation: Yong'in chiqqanda **nima qilish kerakligini** yangi xodimlarga hech kim tushuntirmadi.

sentences.text: Emma can't decide **whether to accept** the offer or wait for something better.
sentences.translation: Emma taklifni **qabul qilsinmi** yoki yaxshiroq narsani kutsinmi — hal qila olmayapti.

sentences.text: Do you know **who to contact** if the internet stops working?
sentences.translation: Internet ishlamay qolsa, **kimga murojaat qilishni** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: At the market in Samarkand, Tom had no idea **how much to pay** for a carpet.
sentences.translation: Samarqand bozorida Tom gilam uchun **qancha to'lashni** umuman bilmasdi.

sentences.text: My grandmother taught me **how to make** proper plov when I was twelve.
sentences.translation: O'n ikki yoshligimda buvim menga haqiqiy palovni **qanday damlashni** o'rgatgan.

sentences.text: I was so surprised that I didn't know **what to say**.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik hayron qoldimki, **nima deyishni** bilmay qoldim.

sentences.text: Before the exam, ask your teacher **when to arrive** and **what to bring**.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan oldin o'qituvchingizdan **qachon kelishni** va **nima olib kelishni** so'rang.

examples.title: Mixed: news, work and everyday life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: promise, appear, refuse, manage, afford, seem to have done, fail, hesitate, tend, how to — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The government **has promised to build** fifty new schools in the region by next year.
sentences.translation: Hukumat kelasi yilgacha viloyatda ellikta yangi maktab **qurishga va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: Our flight **appeared to be** delayed, so we **decided to have** lunch at the airport.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz **kechikadiganga o'xshardi**, shuning uchun aeroportda **tushlik qilishga qaror qildik**.

sentences.text: Madina **refused to give up** and finally **managed to pass** her driving test on the fourth attempt.
sentences.translation: Madina **taslim bo'lmadi** va nihoyat to'rtinchi urinishda haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'ta oldi**.

sentences.text: Few people **can afford to buy** a house in central London these days.
sentences.translation: Hozir Londonning markazida uy **sotib olishga** kamdan-kam odamning **puli yetadi**.

sentences.text: James **seems to have changed** his mind about moving to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Edinburgga ko'chish haqidagi fikridan **qaytganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: If you **fail to renew** your passport in time, you won't be able to travel.
sentences.translation: Pasportingizni o'z vaqtida **yangilay olmasangiz**, sayohat qila olmaysiz.

sentences.text: I **hesitated to ask** for help at first, but my colleagues turned out to be very kind.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga yordam **so'rashga ikkilandim**, lekin hamkasblarim juda mehribon odamlar ekan.

sentences.text: The museum **tends to get** very crowded at weekends, so it's better to go on a weekday.
sentences.translation: Muzey dam olish kunlari **odatda** juda gavjum **bo'ladi**, shuning uchun ish kunida borgan ma'qul.

sentences.text: Do you know **how to get** to the conference centre from the station?
sentences.translation: Vokzaldan konferensiya markaziga **qanday borishni** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Jasur **pretended to be** calm during the interview, but his hands **seemed to be shaking**.
sentences.translation: Suhbat davomida Jasur o'zini **xotirjam ko'rsatdi**, lekin qo'llari **titrayotganga o'xshardi**.
